tool.name: HyperFrames
tool.role: Deterministic HTML/CSS/media composition and MP4 rendering

source_lock.security_requirement: Use this commit or a later signed release proven to contain the static-file path-containment fix from PR #4217.

skills.ecc_policy: Do not bulk-install ECC. Add only audited, non-duplicated capabilities after dry-run.

hard_gates: Read the target channel canonical contract before work.
Keep VSA, Cena Certa and UGI accounts, paths, assets and schedules isolated.
Run lint, validate and inspect before accepting a render.
Verify first frame, transitions and final frame.
Require licensed assets, safe zones, audible audio and CTA through the last frame.
No publish, schedule, merge or deploy from tool adoption alone.
No paid cloud fallback or automatic top-up.
conversation_directive: Any conversation handling Orbit/UGI video work must read AGENTS.md and this file before selecting a renderer or claiming HyperFrames is active in production.
